leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a reactive cart state using Vue's ref or reactive
Construct a cart context provider to share state across components
Implement functions to add and remove items from the cart state
Bind cart data to UI components using computed properties
Integrate the cart context into a component to display cart items
Manipulate the cart state through user interactions like button clicks
Control cart item quantities with increment and decrement handlers
